# tenferro v0.7.0

v0.7.0 delegates the CPU elementwise and max/min kernels to strided-rs 0.4.3,
turns batched CPU linear algebra into tight provider loops, sends every batched
CUDA `eigh` to a batched cuSOLVER routine, adds the polar-based cuSOLVER SVD
driver, and makes the default host scalar value opaque.

## Migration

- Update `tenferro-*` dependency requirements from `0.6` to `0.7` together.
  strided-rs requirements move to `0.4.3`.
- `tenferro_tensor_core::DefaultScalars` (re-exported as
  `tenferro_tensor_core::Tensor` and `tenferro_tensor::core::Tensor`) is now an
  opaque value. The preset variants are no longer public, so `Tensor::F64(..)`
  patterns and constructors, `use Tensor::F64`, and `use Tensor::*` no longer
  compile. Construct with `DefaultScalars::from_vec_col_major` or
  `TensorScalar::into_tensor`, read with `dtype`, `shape`, `as_slice`,
  `as_view`, or `into_vec_col_major::<T>`. `DType`, `TensorScalar`, and sets
  declared with `define_scalar_set!` are unchanged. The runtime `Tensor` in
  `tenferro-tensor` is not affected. ([#1861](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1861))
- Floating point `sum` and `max`/`min` reductions on CPU no longer promise a
  left to right accumulation order. Totals may differ from earlier releases in
  the last bits, and for low precision external scalars that round at every
  step (for example bfloat16) the difference can be larger. Axis reductions stay
  independent of the thread count. For float `max`/`min`, the NaN payload and
  the sign of a zero result are unspecified.
  ([#1877](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1877), [#1881](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1881))

## Features

- `SvdDriver::Xgesvdp` selects the cuSOLVER polar decomposition based SVD for
  CUDA. ([#1851](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1851))
- Every batched CUDA `eigh` goes to a batched cuSOLVER routine, including
  matrices of order above 32.
  ([#1869](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1869))

## Performance

- CPU elementwise kernels and max/min reductions delegate to strided-rs, which
  now hoists the op out of erased dispatch, folds full reductions over
  independent lanes, and sizes axis reduction blocks by bytes. On the strided
  kernel scaling suite (M5 Max, single thread) a typed `max` over all elements
  went from 31.3 ms to 5.2 ms and an erased axis `sum` from 133 ms to 3.2 ms.
  ([#1877](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1877), [#1881](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1881))
- Batched CPU `lu_factor`, `lu_solve`, `triangular_solve`, and related paths run
  as one tight loop per call: one LAPACK workspace query, pooled scratch reused
  across the batch, and results written directly into the batched output.
  `solve` lowers to a fused LU factor and solve.
  ([#1880](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1880))
- The erased `Tensor` shrinks from 1464 B to 776 B, and eager leaves no longer
  open a backend session each. ([#1859](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1859))

## Fixes

- CUDA `axpby` passes 16 byte aligned host coefficients to cuBLAS `geam`.
  ([#1871](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1871))
- A memoized CUDA device address is dropped when a kernel writes the buffer.
  ([#1872](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1872))
- cuTENSOR contraction scratch is shared per stream slot and bounded by a
  separate retention cap (default 10 GiB) instead of the extension cache byte
  budget. ([#1874](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1874), [#1876](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1876))
- The `webgpu` feature of a published `tenferro-gpu` resolves the tensor4all
  FFT fork, published as `t4a-cubek-fft`, instead of the incompatible upstream
  `cubek-fft`. ([#1857](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1857))

## Release process

- Publication verifies that every git pinned dependency matches the crates.io
  archive of the same version. ([#1856](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1856))
- Performance audit rules for delegated kernels and batched linear algebra.
  ([#1879](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1879))
- Released-package dependency pins in the README, getting-started guide, and FFT
  guide name `0.7`.
